notes.title: Paper Planes is Now Fully Localized!
notes.content:
Hey Pilots!

We’re excited to announce that Paper Planes is now fully localized! Players from around the world can now enjoy the game in their native language, making the experience more immersive than ever. We’ve carefully translated all in-game text, menus, and features to ensure smooth and accurate localization across 13 supported languages:

🇨🇳 Chinese (Simplified)
🇹🇼 Chinese (Traditional)
🇬🇧 English
🇫🇷 French
🇩🇪 German
🇮🇹 Italian
🇯🇵 Japanese
🇰🇷 Korean
🇵🇱 Polish
🇵🇹 Portuguese
🇷🇺 Russian
🇪🇸 Spanish
🇹🇷 Turkish
Whether you're soaring solo, racing through time trials, or facing off in multiplayer battles, Paper Planes now speaks your language!

🛠️ Patch Notes:
Full game localization with support for 13 languages.
Various bug fixes and optimizations to improve performance and stability.
Thank you all for your support as we continue to improve and expand Paper Planes! 🚀 We can’t wait to hear your feedback. Let us know what you think in the comments, and we’ll see you in the skies!

Happy flying! 

— The Paper Planes Team

notes.title: Languages coming soon!
notes.content:
Exciting News: Language Selection Coming Soon! 

We’re thrilled to announce that a language selection feature will soon be added to Paper Planes! 🎉 This update will make it easier for players from all around the world to enjoy the game in their preferred language.

At Creekside Interactive, we’re committed to ensuring that everyone can fully experience the fun and excitement of Paper Planes, no matter where they’re from. 

Stay tuned for more updates as we work to make the game more accessible for our growing global community. We can’t wait to share this update with you!

As always, thank you for your continued support and feedback. Happy flying!

notes.title: Patch Notes for Paper Planes Version 0.1.1
notes.content:
Fixes & Adjustments:
1️⃣ Squirrel Targeting Issue:

Addressed an issue where players were unable to target squirrels after they respawned. The squirrels are now fully targetable as intended.
2️⃣ Boosters and Powerups on Backyard Boss Fight:

Added additional boosters and powerups to the Backyard boss fight level to ensure a more engaging and dynamic experience. Take advantage of these new resources to gain an edge!
3️⃣ Powerups in Time Trial Mode:

Adjusted powerups in Time Trial mode to exclusively provide boosters. This ensures a streamlined experience focused on speed and performance for time trial enthusiasts.
Thank You for Your Support!
We appreciate all the feedback from our players. Keep it coming to help us make Paper Planes the best it can be. Fly safe, and happy gaming!

Need support or have suggestions? Join our community on Discord: https://discord.gg/MZy7brk39a

notes.title: 🎮 Full Controller Support & Customization Now in Paper Planes! 🚀
notes.content:
Hey Pilots! ✈️

We’re thrilled to announce some big updates for Paper Planes:

Full Xbox Controller Support:
Navigate through menus and soar through levels effortlessly with native Xbox controller compatibility! Every action, from dodging obstacles to pulling off slick maneuvers, now feels smoother and more intuitive.

Custom Key Bindings:
Prefer your controls a certain way? Now you can set up custom key bindings to make your experience uniquely yours!

Sensitivity Sliders:
Fine-tune your flight controls with sensitivity sliders, allowing you to adjust the precision of your movements and perfect your piloting skills.

These new features were designed with player feedback in mind, and we can't wait for you to experience them in action. Jump back in, try out the updates, and let us know what you think!

Thanks for your ongoing support, and happy flying! 🛫

See you in the skies,
The Paper Planes Team

notes.title: Paper Planes Demo and Beta Multiplayer Patch
notes.content:
This patch brings several key improvements to the Paper Planes Demo and Beta versions! Multiplayer performance is now smoother, addressing previous issues for a more seamless experience. We’ve also fixed the points distribution and award allotment, so players can expect rewards to be tracked and awarded accurately across matches. But that’s not all—Beta branch players can now take on brand-new boss battles! These intense encounters will test your skills and bring an extra layer of excitement to the gameplay. Get ready to challenge these formidable foes and prove your mastery in the skies!

  Pitch and Roll sensitivity sliders have been added to the options menu, making gameplay with a controller smoother and more responsive than ever!

notes.title: Paper Planes Demo Multiplayer Map
notes.content:
We’ve got exciting news, pilots! The Paper Planes Demo just got a major boost with the introduction of a brand-new multiplayer update! Now, you and up to three other players can jump into an exhilarating 2-4 player battle royale mode.

This fast-paced mode takes place on the Park Level, where you’ll face off in an intense showdown to see who will claim victory. The stakes have never been higher as you dodge, dive, and outmaneuver your opponents in a dynamic environment. Every match brings unexpected challenges, and only the sharpest reflexes and smartest strategies will lead you to triumph.

Download the latest update now and experience the thrill of battle royale in Paper Planes like never before. Get ready to take flight, and may the best pilot win!
